text:
maria-cs: Heads-up — ACME sent back the SIG/CAIQ we handed over. They flagged 5 bespoke questions on KMS/HSM, audit-log export, and retention. They want answers by Tue COB (48h). Can someone own this?
ashley-sec: I can take the lead. Quick check: do we have an existing approved wording for HSM usage and key rotation they can accept, or do they want implementation details? :thinking_face:
maria-cs: They asked both — high-level assurances + confirmations on rotation windows and export controls. Also noted an earlier support ticket where they couldn't pull export logs (403). I attached the customer's questionnaire in Zendesk.
sam-engr: Re: the 403 when pulling audit logs — that was due to a missing org-level role binding in their account. Repro steps I used:
```
# curl example reproducing 403
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/ACME/auditlogs?start=2026-03-10&end=2026-03-11"
# response: 403 Forbidden, body: {"error":"insufficient_permissions"}
```
ashley-sec: Good catch. Can you paste the minimal repro and the fix we gave? We'll include that as an appendix to the questionnaire response.
sam-engr: Fix was adding the `audit.export` role at org scope via Console or API:
```
POST /v1/orgs/ACME/roles
{ "role": "audit.export", "principals": ["user:alice@acme.com"] }
```
They also asked about key storage — we use customer-managed keys via KMS integrations for Private deployments; for Hosted we offer envelope encryption with customer-provided CMEK via supported KMS/HSM providers. I'll draft exact wording.
vince-legal: From compliance side, confirm we can include standard CAIQ language about key escrow and lack thereof. We should avoid implying unlimited retention of raw logs; stick to retention policy + deletion timelines.
ashley-sec: Agreed. Proposed sections for the response: 1) KMS/HSM architecture & supported providers 2) Key rotation and rotation windows (30/90 day patterns, customer-controlled for CMEK) 3) Audit log collection, export methods, and RBAC for exports 4) Retention policy and deletion SLAs (hosted: default 90 days, enterprise configurable up to 7 years) 5) Repro steps & mitigation for the 403 case 6) Evidence links (internal runbook + screenshots).
incident-bot: [ticket-2026-ACME-489] Created a follow-up support case and attached the questionnaire PDF.
maria-cs: Perfect. Ashley — can you draft the response by EOD today so I can review and send? Also confirm whether we can produce an export of <30 days of raw audit logs for their security team (they asked for a 14-day bulk export).
ashley-sec: I'll draft now. We can produce a 14-day bulk export for Enterprise customers via secure S3 presigned link; note that exports are subject to IAM checks and will only include metadata + events (no PII). I'll add standard phrasing and request template for the export. :thumbsup:
sam-engr: I'll add the sample API payload and the exact HTTP 403 troubleshooting steps to the appendix.
vince-legal: Adding: do not promise retention beyond what's contractually agreed. I'll review wording for liability.
maria-cs: Thanks team — I'll slot this for review at 16:00. If we need any attestation docs (signed statements on HSM usage), flag here.
ashley-sec: If legal wants it we can provide the KMS architecture diagram and the HSM provider SLA summary. Will ping if needed. :eyes:
